inputs.xtext_rule_text:
Specialization returns SysML::Specialization :
    ( 'specialization' Identification? )?
    'subtype' 
	( specific = [SysML::Type | QualifiedName]
	| ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain )
    ( ':>' | 'specializes') 
	( general = [SysML::Type | QualifiedName]
	| ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain )
	RelationshipBody
;

decision: KerML 8.2.4.1.2 states Specialization = ( 'specialization' Identification )? 'subtype' SpecificType SPECIALIZES GeneralType RelationshipBody. The KerML Xtext writes the optional name part as `( 'specialization' Identification? )?`; the specification's Identification can already be empty, so the inner '?' adds nothing, and inlines SpecificType and GeneralType as `[QualifiedName] | OwnedFeatureChain`; the inlining is not ported. SPECIALIZES is the special lexical terminal of KerML 8.2.2.7, written out as keyword alternatives. The rule is the clause as written.
